title: RTEC Title VI / LEP binder and attachment assembly workflow

historical_binder_cover.significance: Shows that a stand-alone physical/electronic Title VI/LEP binder was maintained as a period-specific compliance package.

attachments.title: Letter Notifying Complainant that the Complaint Is Not Substantiated
Letter Notifying Complainant that the Complaint Is Substantiated
List of Transit-Related Title VI Complaints
Copy of Letter and Advertisement for Notice of Public Hearing

current_plan_relationship.observation: The plan retains the same general attachment concept: translated/public notice material, complaint form/correspondence, complaint-history evidence and public-hearing/outreach evidence support the narrative plan.

compilation_steps: Start from the approved current Title VI/LEP plan version and its table of contents/required attachments.
Resolve each attachment slot to one current canonical source rather than copying whatever file exists in an older binder.
Validate public contact information, filing/appeal windows, web domain, relay information and translated text against the governing plan before publication.
Generate or insert the current Spanish/LEP public-facing service material.
Insert current public notice and complaint form.
Insert current acknowledgement/finding/closure correspondence templates only after their deadlines and appeal language are reconciled to the current plan.
Insert a privacy-safe aggregate complaint/investigation list; do not place case narratives or person-level records in the general binder.
Insert the applicable public-hearing/outreach notice and evidence for the reporting/submission period.
Record plan approval, submission transmittal and state approval/acceptance correspondence as separate provenance artifacts.
Freeze a manifest of source IDs, hashes, effective dates and attachment versions for the submitted binder.
controls: Binder cover period must match the actual plan/submission period.
Do not let an older attachment survive into a new binder merely because its filename looks current.
Attachment templates must inherit deadlines/contact data from the governing plan.
Translated/public notices must be versioned with the English source content.
State submission and approval evidence should be retained separately from internal Board approval.
known_drift_examples: The archive contains a 2020-2022 binder cover alongside later 2023/2026 plan versions.
The current-looking complaint closure template contains a seven-day reconsideration period while the January 2026 plan states a 90-day appeal period.
A public notice labeled revised October 2016 remained exposed on the observed public site even though a January 2026 plan exists.
A file named '2023 Cover Letter' actually prints a January 2026 date.
automation_candidates: Manifest-driven Title VI binder builder that blocks submission when an attachment effective date predates the governing plan without an explicit waiver.
Cross-document consistency checks for coordinator, phone, domain, filing window, appeal window and translated contact information.
Generate attachment index/cover automatically from canonical source IDs and submission period.
Privacy check that prevents populated complaint/case records from entering the general binder.
